meta.title: Choomantar

victim.name: Naina Kapoor
victim.description: Outgoing and quick to laugh, and far more grown-up than the rest of them. She was the mother of the group, and the one everybody told their secrets to.

meta.tone: haunted-house horror, whispered chants, guttering candlelight and things moving just out of sight; the ghost is only a rumour, the danger is real
meta.premise: Four kids enter a haunted house on a dare, and only three will come out. One of them is already dead inside, and one of the other three is the reason why. They must find the killer before the night is over.

suspects.name: Arjun Bose
suspects.description: The quiet one, always carrying a notebook. He reads everything twice and says very little.
suspects.public_alibi: Says he spent the hour in the kitchen, boiling water for tea. Nobody saw him there.
suspects.motive: Naina had joked all week that she would tell his father why he was always broke.
suspects.secret: You have been taking money from your father's till every week since June, and Naina knew. At half past eleven you took your slip from her tin, burned it in the kitchen stove, and washed the ash off at the courtyard pump.

suspects.name: Dev Malhotra
suspects.description: Captain of the school cricket team, and the one who dared everybody into the haveli. Loud, funny and very good at being liked.
suspects.public_alibi: Says he spent the hour on the terrace roof, hunting for phone signal. Nobody saw him.
suspects.motive: He and Naina had been fighting for weeks. Last Friday she called him a coward in front of the whole team.
suspects.secret: Two months ago, after the Diwali fair, you took your brother's scooter and knocked an old man off his bicycle on Fair Road. You rode away. Only Naina knew, and tonight she told you to confess by Monday or she would. At a quarter to twelve you followed her to the tank and did not let her come back up.

suspects.name: Zoya Qureshi
suspects.description: Runs a horror channel with a few thousand followers. Sharp, nosy and never without her phone.
suspects.public_alibi: Says she spent the hour in the library with the door shut, reading by phone light. Nobody saw her.
suspects.motive: Naina had banned her from posting about the friends after a fight last month.
suspects.secret: At eleven you hid a camera in the niche above the tank, hoping to film the midnight chant for your channel. At 11:41 you texted Naina to meet you there so you could confess, then lost your nerve and hid in the library.

world.killer_method: At a quarter to twelve Dev followed Naina to the courtyard tank, where she was setting the ritual bowl. She had texted him to confess, and he came to beg, then to silence her. He held her under until she stopped, pulled off his soaked cricket hoodie, hid it behind the trunk in the east corridor, and was in the great hall by midnight, claiming he had been on the terrace roof. Motive: Naina knew he had left an old man hurt on Fair Road, and would tell the police on Monday.

clues.text: A damp page from Naina's notebook: 'Fair Road. The old man in hospital. Monday I tell the police, whoever it hurts.'
The red scooter in the yard has a bent front mudguard, and a strip of grey cloth is caught in the crack.
The terrace door is chained, and its padlock is red with rust and furred with cobwebs. Nobody has been through it in years.
A soaked cricket hoodie with the school badge is stuffed behind the corridor trunk. It reeks of tank water.
Naina's phone: a text sent at 11:44 to a contact saved as 'Captain': 'Courtyard. Last chance to say it yourself.'
A newspaper clipping from Naina's bag: a hit-and-run on Fair Road two months ago, and a witness who saw a red scooter with a cricket-ball sticker.
Zoya heard Naina whisper to Dev on the staircase at twenty past eleven: 'Monday. Not a day more.'
Arjun's sleeves are wet to the elbow, and there is grey ash under his nails.
An unread text on Naina's phone, sent at 11:41 by Zoya: 'Courtyard. Now. I mean it.'
A half-burnt slip in the kitchen stove, in Arjun's handwriting: 'from Papa's till, every week since June. Naina knows.'

items.name: Zoya's camera
items.description: A small action camera taped into a phone case. Its card still holds tonight.

items.name: Naina's red thread
items.description: The protection thread she tied on every wrist. It still smells of her shampoo.

items.name: Kerosene lantern
items.description: A kerosene lantern. Its flame is small, but it holds.

finale.proof: The camera's card holds forty seconds of dark footage. A hooded boy kneels at the tank at 11:46, the school badge catching the lamp, and Naina's hands grip the stone. With the rusted padlock, the soaked hoodie, the text to Captain and the dented scooter, it was Dev Malhotra.
finale.frame: Wet sleeves, ash under the nails, and a half-burnt slip that says Naina knew his secret. Arjun washed at the pump twenty paces from the tank. It all points at Arjun Bose.

scenes.intro: A little after midnight, Naina Kapoor floats face down in the courtyard tank, her dupatta spread on the water. The gate is chained from outside, and the caretaker will not return before dawn. Who followed her here?

1.text: check Naina for a pulse
1.recap: {player} knelt on the wet stones and felt for a pulse at Naina's wrist.

on_success.narration: {player} unties the red thread from Naina's wrist. Her skin is cold, and her hair is still dripping.

on_failure.narration: {player} cannot make himself touch her, and his hands hover and shake.

1.text: scrub the ash from your hands
1.recap: {player} slipped over to the iron hand-pump and scrubbed at his hands.

on_success.narration: {player} works the pump until the grey ash is gone from under his nails. Nobody notices.

on_failure.narration: {player} scrubs hard, but the grey streaks stay under his nails.

1.text: search Naina's bag
1.recap: {player} bent over Naina's school bag and began to go through it.

on_success.narration: {player} spreads a torch, a notebook and a folded newspaper clipping on the stones. The clipping is about a hit-and-run.

on_failure.narration: {player} fumbles the zip, and it jams halfway.

1.text: slip Naina's phone into your pocket
1.recap: {player} stayed crouched over Naina's bag a moment too long.

on_success.narration: {player} rises and says nothing, one hand in a pocket.

on_failure.narration: {player} grabs for the phone, and it skids across the stones and goes dark.

2.text: close Naina's eyes
2.recap: {player} knelt beside Naina and reached for her face.

on_success.narration: {player} closes her eyes with two fingers, whispers something too low to hear, and steps back with his jaw tight.

on_failure.narration: {player} reaches out, but his fingers will not stop trembling.

2.text: stay back by the doorway
2.recap: {player} stayed back by the doorway, well away from the water.

on_success.narration: {player} grips the door frame and breathes slowly. His face gives nothing away.

on_failure.narration: {player} backs into the door frame, white as paper.

2.text: ask who saw her last
2.recap: {player} asked who had seen Naina last.

on_success.narration: {player} gets an answer out loud: Naina went to set the ritual bowl by the tank at a quarter to twelve.

on_failure.narration: {player} asks, and the question falls flat in the empty courtyard.

2.text: wipe your hands on your jeans
2.recap: {player} stood very still and wiped his hands on his jeans.

on_success.narration: {player} dries his palms and keeps well back from the tank.

on_failure.narration: {player} rubs his palms again and again, and cannot stop shaking.

3.text: help lift Naina onto the stones
3.recap: {player} took hold of Naina's cold hands to help drag her up onto the stones.

on_success.narration: {player} lays Naina flat. Her palms are scraped raw from the lip of the tank.

on_failure.narration: {player} slips on the wet stone and nearly goes into the water herself.

3.text: keep your eyes off the niche
3.recap: {player} kept her eyes on the floor and never looked up at the wall.

on_success.narration: {player} breathes out slowly, sure that nobody saw her glance up earlier.

on_failure.narration: {player} glances up at the dark niche, and her face gives her away.

3.text: search Naina's pockets
3.recap: {player} went through the pockets of Naina's school blazer.

on_success.narration: {player} unfolds a damp notebook page and reads it aloud: Fair Road, the old man, Monday.

on_failure.narration: {player} finds only a hair tie and a ticket stub.

3.text: drift toward the north wall
3.recap: {player} drifted toward the north wall and stopped under the niche.

on_success.narration: {player} sees a tiny lens glint in the dark and says nothing.

on_failure.narration: {player} cannot see into the niche, and the wall is slick with moss.

scenes.intro: In the great hall, an oil lamp throws long shadows across Naina's things, laid out on a table. Each of you says where you were between half past eleven and midnight, and each story has a hole. Who is lying?

1.text: read the notebook pages on the table
1.recap: {player} sat at the table and smoothed out the notebook pages from Naina's pocket.

on_success.narration: {player} reads one page aloud in a flat voice: Fair Road, the old man in hospital, Monday.

on_failure.narration: {player} squints at the ink, which has run into grey clouds.

1.text: keep your tea story straight
1.recap: {player} said he had spent the hour boiling tea in the kitchen.

on_success.narration: {player} sticks to his story and says nothing about the courtyard pump.

on_failure.narration: {player} says kitchen, then courtyard, then kitchen again.

1.text: look at the red scooter in the yard
1.recap: {player} walked out to the yard and crouched beside the red scooter by the broken wall.

on_success.narration: {player} spots a bent front mudguard, and a strip of grey cloth caught in the crack.

on_failure.narration: {player} circles the scooter in the dark and sees nothing but rust.

1.text: watch who flinches at Naina's name
1.recap: {player} said Naina's name and watched the faces around him.

on_success.narration: {player} sees one face go still, and keeps what he saw to himself.

on_failure.narration: {player} watches, but the lamplight makes every face look the same.

2.text: test the gate chain for a weak link
2.recap: {player} went to the gate and tested the chain with both hands.

on_success.narration: {player} confirms the padlock is on the outside and the chain is solid. Nobody is leaving before dawn.

on_failure.narration: {player} rattles the chain until his palms sting, and it does not give.

2.text: say you were on the roof
2.recap: {player} said he had spent the hour on the terrace roof, hunting for phone signal.

on_success.narration: {player} tells it lightly, one thumb tapping his phone. Nobody challenges him yet.

on_failure.narration: {player} says it a little too fast, and nobody quite looks at him.

2.text: ask where Zoya really was
2.recap: {player} turned to Zoya and asked where she had really been.

on_success.narration: {player} gets a shaky answer: the library, alone, with the door shut. Nobody can vouch for it.

on_failure.narration: {player} asks, and Zoya only stares back at him.

2.text: loudly point out Arjun's wet sleeves
2.recap: {player} pointed at Arjun's sleeves and said they were soaked to the elbow.

on_success.narration: {player} says it twice, loud enough to stick, and Arjun's face drains of colour.

on_failure.narration: {player} points, but the lamp is too dim to show anything.

2.exposure: {player} loudly pointed out that Arjun's sleeves were soaked to the elbow.

3.text: light every lamp in the hall
3.recap: {player} set about lighting the lamps in the hall.

on_success.narration: {player} fills the hall with a low yellow glow, and carries a kerosene lantern to the table.

on_failure.narration: {player} runs out of matches after the second lamp.

3.text: keep your phone face down
3.recap: {player} laid her phone face down on the table and left it there.

on_success.narration: {player} keeps her thumb on the wood and her face blank.

on_failure.narration: {player}'s phone buzzes against the table, and every eye flicks toward it.

3.text: say what you heard from the library
3.recap: {player} told them what she had heard from the library.

on_success.narration: {player} describes a thin whisper from the courtyard around midnight, like a word said over and over.

on_failure.narration: {player} starts to explain and loses the thread.

3.text: look at Arjun's wet sleeves
3.recap: {player} studied Arjun's sleeves and the grey under his nails.

on_success.narration: {player} sees damp cloth and ash, and files it away to herself.

on_failure.narration: {player} looks, but Arjun turns away and tugs his sleeves down.

scenes.intro: The oil lamp gutters and dies, and the great hall drops into total dark. Upstairs a door bangs twice in the east corridor, and below, a pan clatters in the kitchen. Where do you look first?

1.text: light the lamp again
1.recap: {player} struck match after match, trying to relight the lamp.

on_success.narration: {player} coaxes the wick alight, and a small yellow circle pushes the dark back.

on_failure.narration: {player} burns two fingers on a match, and the wick stays dead.

1.text: slip into the kitchen alone
1.recap: {player} felt his way toward the kitchen in the dark.

on_success.narration: {player} stands at the cold stove, heart hammering, and listens to the pan rock to a stop.

on_failure.narration: {player} walks into a hanging pot, and the clang echoes through the house.

1.text: follow the banging up the east stairs
1.recap: {player} started up the stairs after the banging.

on_success.narration: {player} finds a door swinging on its hinge and wedges it open with a loose brick.

on_failure.narration: {player} climbs three steps and loses his nerve in the dark.

1.text: go through Naina's bag in the dark
1.recap: {player} slipped his hand into Naina's bag in the dark.

on_success.narration: {player} closes his fingers around a folded paper and says nothing.

on_failure.narration: {player} finds only a torch with no battery.

2.text: light a match and call out
2.recap: {player} struck a match and called into the dark.

on_success.narration: {player} holds the little flame high, and a pale face swims out of the black.

on_failure.narration: {player}'s match gutters out after one second.

2.text: slip away toward the east stairs
2.recap: {player} drifted toward the east stairs in the dark.

on_success.narration: {player} climbs without a sound and is back before the lamp is relit.

on_failure.narration: {player} stubs his foot on the bottom step and freezes, listening.

2.text: call out and count voices
2.recap: {player} called into the dark and counted the replies.

on_success.narration: {player} hears two shaky answers and lets out a long breath.

on_failure.narration: {player} calls and calls, and only the echoes answer.

2.text: whisper that Zoya is hiding something
2.recap: {player} leaned close in the dark and whispered about Zoya.

on_success.narration: {player} lets the doubt hang in the dark, quiet and sharp.

on_failure.narration: {player} whispers, but Zoya hears every word.

2.exposure: {player} was heard whispering in the dark that Zoya was hiding something.

3.text: wind up Naina's torch
3.recap: {player} set to winding Naina's wind-up torch.

on_success.narration: {player} sweeps a thin beam across the hall, and the shadows jump.

on_failure.narration: {player} cranks until her arm aches, and the beam only flickers.

3.text: slip back to the library
3.recap: {player} slipped back toward the library with her phone clutched to her chest.

on_success.narration: {player} shuts the library door and leans on it, shaking.

on_failure.narration: {player} bumps into a bookcase, and a dozen books hit the floor.

3.text: listen for the whisper at the tank
3.recap: {player} stood at the courtyard door and listened for the whisper.

on_success.narration: {player} hears only wind in the old pipes, though the word seems to hang in the air.

on_failure.narration: {player} hears her own breathing and nothing else.

3.text: try the doors up the east stairs
3.recap: {player} slipped up the east stairs and tried the doors one by one.

on_success.narration: {player} finds a chain on the terrace door, with a padlock red with rust, and notes it.

on_failure.narration: {player} finds every door painted shut and comes back with dusty hands.

scenes.intro: The east corridor is long and cold, lined with carved doors that have not opened in years. A heavy trunk squats at the far end, and a chained door leads up to the terrace. What was hidden up here?

1.text: check the carved doors
1.recap: {player} walked the corridor and tried each carved door in turn.

on_success.narration: {player} finds every door painted shut except one, and it hides only spiders.

on_failure.narration: {player} gives up after the second door and rubs his dusty hands.

1.text: sit on the stairs and breathe
1.recap: {player} sat on the cold stairs with his head between his knees.

on_success.narration: {player} breathes slowly until the shaking stops.

on_failure.narration: {player} hears footsteps above him and cannot make himself move.

1.text: drag the heavy trunk aside
1.recap: {player} put his shoulder to the heavy trunk.

on_success.narration: {player} drags it out from the wall and finds a soaked cricket hoodie stuffed behind it, reeking of tank water.

on_failure.narration: {player} strains at the trunk, and it will not shift.

1.text: dig through the trunk's old saris
1.recap: {player} lifted the trunk's lid and dug through the old saris inside.

on_success.narration: {player} finds a kerosene lantern wrapped in cloth and keeps it close.

on_failure.narration: {player} lifts the lid, and a cloud of moth dust sets him coughing.

2.text: hold the lantern for the search
2.recap: {player} held a light high while the corridor was searched.

on_success.narration: {player} keeps the light steady, though his eyes keep sliding to the far end.

on_failure.narration: {player}'s hand shakes, and the light jumps across the walls.

2.text: stay at the top of the stairs
2.recap: {player} stood at the top of the stairs, watching the dark below.

on_success.narration: {player} keeps his back to the wall and his eyes on the corridor.

on_failure.narration: {player} paces the landing until the boards complain.

2.text: tear the curtain from the window
2.recap: {player} tore the rotted curtain from the corridor window.

on_success.narration: {player} lets in a thin grey light, and the corridor looks bare and ordinary.

on_failure.narration: {player} brings down the whole curtain pole with a crash.

2.text: slip a hand into someone's pocket
2.recap: {player} brushed against {target} in the narrow corridor.

on_success.narration: {player} moves on without a word, one hand tucked away.

on_failure.narration: {player} fumbles, and something small drops between them.

2.exposure: {player} was caught with a hand in {target}'s pocket.

3.text: try the chained terrace door
3.recap: {player} climbed the stairs and tried the chained door to the terrace.

on_success.narration: {player} finds the padlock red with rust and the chain furred with cobwebs. Nobody has passed this door in years.

on_failure.narration: {player} tugs at the chain, and it will not give.

3.text: hold your phone up for signal
3.recap: {player} held her phone high in the dark, hunting for a signal.

on_success.narration: {player} gets one flickering bar and then nothing.

on_failure.narration: {player} stares at the dead screen and swallows hard.

3.text: knock on the walls for hollow spots
3.recap: {player} knocked along the corridor wall, listening for hollow places.

on_success.narration: {player} finds an old servants' stair behind a curtain, and notes that it comes out by the courtyard.

on_failure.narration: {player} hears only solid stone.

3.text: look for wet footprints on the stairs
3.recap: {player} crouched with a light and studied the stairs for footprints.

on_success.narration: {player} finds a faint trail of damp prints heading up, and keeps quiet about it.

on_failure.narration: {player} finds only dust and her own shadow.

scenes.intro: The kitchen smells of cold coal and old ghee, and a copper pan still rocks on the floor. Beyond it, the mirror room waits behind its cracked glass. Who has been through here tonight?

1.text: hang the rocking pan back up
1.recap: {player} reached for the copper pan to hang it back up.

on_success.narration: {player} finds the wall behind it damp, and the damp smells of tank water.

on_failure.narration: {player} drops the pan, and the clang rolls through the house.

1.text: shove your hands in your pockets
1.recap: {player} shoved his hands in his pockets and said nothing about the stove.

on_success.narration: {player} stays still and keeps his face blank, sure the grey ash has not been noticed.

on_failure.narration: {player} watches the stove too closely, and his eyes keep returning to it.

1.text: study the kitchen floor for tracks
1.recap: {player} crouched and studied the kitchen floor for tracks.

on_success.narration: {player} finds a line of drips leading from the courtyard door to the east stairs.

on_failure.narration: {player} finds only old grease and a dead moth.

1.text: search the mirror room alone
1.recap: {player} slipped into the mirror room and stood before the cracked glass.

on_success.narration: {player} sees himself broken into a dozen pieces and finds a cold brass key under a loose panel.

on_failure.narration: {player} sees only his own white face, over and over.

2.text: feed coal to the stove
2.recap: {player} fed coal to the stove and blew on the embers.

on_success.narration: {player} gets a small fire going, and the kitchen glows orange.

on_failure.narration: {player} blows until he is dizzy, and the coal will not catch.

2.text: keep to the doorway's shadow
2.recap: {player} stood in the shadow of the doorway and watched.

on_success.narration: {player} keeps still and listens to the house settle.

on_failure.narration: {player} shifts his weight, and a floorboard shrieks.

2.text: rake out the stove and read what's left
2.recap: {player} raked the stove out onto the floor and picked through the ash.

on_success.narration: {player} holds up a half-burnt slip of paper: 'from Papa's till, every week since June. Naina knows.'

on_failure.narration: {player} burns his fingers on the grate and finds only cinders.

2.text: feed a scrap into the stove
2.recap: {player} stood close to the stove with one hand behind his back.

on_success.narration: {player} turns away from the stove with his face blank.

on_failure.narration: {player} knocks the coal scuttle over, and it rings like a bell.

2.exposure: {player} was caught feeding a scrap of evidence into the stove.

3.text: wipe the cracked mirror
3.recap: {player} wiped the dust from the cracked mirror with her sleeve.

on_success.narration: {player} sees the room behind her, and nothing moves in it.

on_failure.narration: {player} cuts her thumb on the broken glass.

3.text: stay out of the kitchen
3.recap: {player} lingered in the doorway and went no further.

on_success.narration: {player} stays where she can see both ways, and breathes.

on_failure.narration: {player} hears the pan rocking and cannot take another step.

3.text: look out the kitchen window at the yard
3.recap: {player} wiped the grimy kitchen window and looked out into the yard.

on_success.narration: {player} sees the red scooter by the broken wall, its front mudguard bent and a grey rag caught in the crack.

on_failure.narration: {player} sees only a dark shape and a puddle.

3.text: rake through the stove ash
3.recap: {player} knelt at the stove and raked through the ash with a spoon.

on_success.narration: {player} pulls out a half-burnt slip of paper and slides it into her sleeve.

on_failure.narration: {player} finds only cinders and a blackened thumb.

scenes.intro: Back in the courtyard, the tank lies black and still, and the iron swing creaks without any wind. High on the north wall, a stone niche holds something that glints. Who knows what is up there?

1.text: go through Naina's blazer by the pump
1.recap: {player} went through the blazer Naina had left folded on the pump.

on_success.narration: {player} finds a damp notebook page in the pocket: Fair Road, the old man, Monday, whoever it hurts.

on_failure.narration: {player} finds only a comb and a packet of mints.

1.text: stay in the pillar's shadow
1.recap: {player} stayed in the shadow of the pillar with his hands in his pockets.

on_success.narration: {player} breathes easier in the dark, away from the light.

on_failure.narration: {player} steps on a loose stone, and the whole courtyard hears it.

1.text: climb to the niche
1.recap: {player} climbed the cracked wall toward the stone niche, one handhold at a time.

on_success.narration: {player} reaches the niche, takes a small camera from it, and climbs back down with it.

on_failure.narration: {player} grabs a handhold that crumbles and falls hard against the wall.

on_death.narration: {player} fell from the wall onto the stone rim of the tank, and did not get up.

1.text: watch the niche from the dark
1.recap: {player} stood in the dark and watched the niche for a long time.

on_success.narration: {player} becomes sure there is a lens up there, and tells nobody.

on_failure.narration: {player} sees only shadows and tells himself it is the wind.

2.text: carry the lantern round the tank
2.recap: {player} carried a light slowly around the edge of the tank.

on_success.narration: {player} keeps the light low and the water dark.

on_failure.narration: {player} nearly slips on the wet stone and curses.

2.text: keep away from the water
2.recap: {player} kept well away from the water.

on_success.narration: {player} stands by the arch and keeps his hands in plain sight.

on_failure.narration: {player} flinches when a ripple crosses the tank.

2.text: check the stone drain by the tank
2.recap: {player} crouched at the stone drain beside the tank and ran a hand along it.

on_success.narration: {player} finds nothing but weeds and slime.

on_failure.narration: {player} gets a handful of black mud and nothing else.

2.text: knock a find into the tank
2.recap: {player} stood close to the tank, near where the finds lay on the stones.

on_success.narration: {player} nudges something with his heel, and it slides under the black water.

on_failure.narration: {player} stubs his toe on the stone rim and swears.

2.exposure: {player} was caught knocking one of the finds into the tank.

3.text: tell them what you heard on the stairs
3.recap: {player} told them what she had overheard on the staircase.

on_success.narration: {player} says it flat: Naina told Dev, in a whisper at twenty past eleven, 'Monday. Not a day more.'

on_failure.narration: {player} starts to speak, then cannot finish the sentence.

3.text: say nothing about the niche
3.recap: {player} said nothing about the niche and kept her eyes on the swing.

on_success.narration: {player} keeps her secret one hour longer.

on_failure.narration: {player} stares at the niche for one second too long.

3.text: admit the camera and hand it over
3.recap: {player} admitted she had hidden a camera in the niche and started up the wall for it.

on_success.narration: {player} climbs the cracked wall and returns with a small camera, its red light still blinking.

on_failure.narration: {player} reaches for the niche, but her fingers close on air.

3.text: climb up and keep the camera
3.recap: {player} started up the wall to the niche on her own.

on_success.narration: {player} tucks the camera into her jacket and says nothing.

on_failure.narration: {player} climbs halfway, loses her grip, and drops back to the stones.

scenes.intro: A voice whispers 'choomantar' from somewhere near the tank, then stops whenever anyone listens. The oil runs low, and every lamp in the house sinks to a dull orange. Who do you still trust?

1.text: trace the whisper to its source
1.recap: {player} followed the whisper along the wall.

on_success.narration: {player} puts his ear to the pipe and hears only wind. The word was never a voice.

scenes.intro: The oil is nearly gone, and the gate chain still hangs solid. Someone could climb out to the roof for a signal or crawl through the cellar hatch for the caretaker's tools. Who dares?

solved.title: The Captain
solved.epilogue: The vote lands on Dev, and he does not argue for long. When the caretaker's key turns at dawn, a constable is already waiting at the gate. Arjun's ash was his own secret, burned to hide the till. Zoya's text was a confession she never finished. {victim} kept everyone's secrets until the end, and only Dev's was worth killing for.

wrong_culprit.title: The Wrong Door
wrong_culprit.epilogue: The vote lands on {accused}, and the courtyard turns on them until the caretaker's key turns at dawn. Dev says nothing at all. The ash, the wet sleeves and the half-burnt slip meant nothing, and the camera in the niche was never watched. By the time anyone asks about Fair Road, the scooter has been repainted. {victim}'s killer walks out of the gate with the rest.

culprit_escapes.title: Dawn Comes Too Late
culprit_escapes.epilogue: Nobody names the killer, or too many names fly at once. When the caretaker's key turns at dawn, the tank is still and the soaked hoodie is still behind the trunk. Dev walks out through the gate with a steady face. The ash, the wet sleeves and the unsent confession were all secrets, and none of them was the murder. {victim} is carried out last.
